branches.theme: Sectors and Segments of a Circle

details: Sector: Region enclosed by two radii and an arc.
Arc length of sector angle θ: L = (θ / 360°) * 2πr
Area of sector angle θ: A = (θ / 360°) * πr^2
evidence_or_examples: Area swept by 14 cm minute hand in 5 min (θ = 30°): A = (30/360) * (22/7) * 196 = 154/3 cm^2.

details: Segment: Region bounded by a chord and an arc.
Area of minor segment = Area of sector - Area of inner triangle
Area of inner triangle in sector θ: (1/2) r^2 sin θ
evidence_or_examples: Chord subtends 60° with r = 15 cm: sector area = 117.75 cm^2, equilateral triangle area = 97.3125 cm^2 => minor segment = 20.4375 cm^2.
4 quadrants of radius 7 cm cut from 14 cm square: remaining area = 196 - 154 = 42 cm^2.
